contributor to MP (1898, 1899)

She published an anthology of devotional material (1893). She was daughter of John Colquhoun (1805-1885) and sister of the novelist Lucy Bethia (Colquhoun) Walford, who also contributed to MP; she married the Rev. Arthur Hastings Berger (1845-1934).
